chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Game is not to be slaughtered in the Haram, even if it was hunted in the hill.

key_terms.الْحِلِّ: the area outside the sacred boundary

ai.seo_question: Can hunted game be slaughtered inside the Haram if it was caught outside it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning game and the sanctity of the Haram. It states that game may not be slaughtered within the Sacred Sanctuary, even if it was hunted outside its boundaries.
